story.title: The Dish: Acquolina brings Italian fare to the slopes of Camp Bowie District
story.summary: Expect the restaurant to warm up west Fort Worth with its Aspen-inspired apres ski Italian food coming winter of 2027. If you’ve finished a day skiing the slopes of Aspen by seeking fuel and comfort at Acquolina, an Italian trattoria and pizzeria on Main Street, this news likely already caught your attention. Next winter, you won’t have to be mired in post-ski trip adrenaline fatigue either, thanks to Acquolina bringing its wood-fired Roman-style pizzas and other Italian dishes to Fort Worth. You can look forward to more Texas-oriented items, too, followed soon by a neighboring Japanese steakhouse. The trattoria will be located in the former site of Bella Italia, at the southwest corner of Camp Bowie Boulevard and Merrick Street in the historic Camp Bowie District.
